findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 4 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 64 questions numbered 1-64; by section: 4.1 9, 4.2 4, 4.3 8, 4.4 10, 4.5 15, 4.6 5, 4.7 5, 4.8 8.

Covers sections 4.1-4.8 in order (non-conservative forces under 4.3; kinetic and potential energy under 4.5); comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use values changed from the book's examples and were recomputed in Python with g = 9.8 m s⁻²; none repeats the chapter exercise.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
